description: On the table there’s a gray plastic bin with a few ice cubes inside, a small yellow cup of ice to the left, and a purple dustpan on the right. The left hand reaches forward to grasp the yellow cup, lifts it up and over the gray bin, then tilts and rotates the cup so the ice cubes tumble into the bin before bringing the cup back down; the right hand stays hovering near the dustpan without touching anything.
